intro.title: Explore Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal
intro.description: Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal is located at Avenue, corner of, Tiradentes 3456, Santo Domingo 10514, Dominican Republic. It is one of the most important baseball stadiums in the Dominican Republic and an important venue for the Dominican Professional Baseball League (LIDOM). The stadium has become an important sports and cultural landmark in Santo Domingo with its rich baseball history and excellent facilities.

officialManagement.title: About Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal
officialManagement.text: Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal is a famous baseball stadium in Santo Domingo, featuring rich baseball history and excellent sports facilities. It is an important sports and cultural landmark loved by local residents and tourists.

historyTimeline.title: Historical Timeline

items.title: Early Period: Stadium Construction
items.description: The construction of Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal aimed to provide an important baseball venue for Santo Domingo citizens, and has long been regarded as an important sports and cultural landmark by local residents.

items.title: 20th Century: Facility Improvement
items.description: With the development of baseball in the Dominican Republic, the stadium gradually improved game-watching facilities and related services, becoming an important venue for Dominican professional baseball.

items.title: 21st Century: Sports Landmark
items.description: Entering the 21st century, with its rich baseball history and important cultural value, it has attracted more tourists and become an important sports and cultural landmark in Santo Domingo.

historyTimeline.guideContent: When visiting, you can start by entering the stadium area from the main entrance on Avenida Tiradentes; then walk around the stadium to enjoy the architecture and exterior landscapes; if you have enough time, you can learn about the stadium's baseball history and cultural value. Finally, explore the urban scenery around the stadium and feel the charm of the Dominican capital.
